title: The existing coefficient models of the PBC rational purity presentation
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W, use the lifted datum and bounded constructible complete categories of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Define the coefficient system with ring pbcAdicCompletion and the canonical inverse-image maps of [lem-cbc-integral-compact-support-uniform-restriction], its separate proper/open image [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], and its completed pullback followed by the published Tate tensor and [2d] [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. The existing normalized coefficient-model API identifies these operations with the intrinsic coefficient presentation of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]: the ordinary Tate comparison fixes section elements, the ordinary scalar comparison fixes tensor generators, and the derived scalar comparison is normalized by its universal counit. The six-factor Tate/scalar comparison is the fully faithful preimage of those published comparisons and [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar]. The accompanying already proved lemmas give geometric bounds in the finite-field setting, membership in the intrinsic model, and preservation of bounded constructible complete lattices by actual completed pullback. This node only relocates the existing Lean API of the parent with every signature and construction unchanged; it introduces no replacement notion.

proof.text: The coefficient system and ambient operations are the original displayed constructions, with no proof obligation or new choice.

The ordinary Tate transport is the identity-section restriction round trip. The ordinary scalar comparison is the published tensor-generator comparison; cancellation of its universal counit proves uniqueness after localization. Compose the normalized comparisons and cancel the fully faithful model to obtain the Tate/scalar comparison. All Lean bodies are preserved verbatim.

For pullback preservation, apply the uniform reduction criterion, reflect homology vanishing through coefficient restriction, apply constructible reduction pullback and its intrinsic criterion, then transport across the actual completed-pullback tower isomorphism. This is the original completed proof.

Finite type over the finite field gives Noetherianity and a finite dimension bound; the structure morphism takes the inverse of l in the field to an inverse in every stalk. The existing geometric-bounds proof is unchanged.
